title: govenia utriculata var. capitata
intro: Govenia utriculata var. capitata, commonly known as the 'Queen of the Night', is a species of flowering orchid native to Central and South America. This plant is valued for its unique ability to bloom only at night, emitting a strong fragrance that attracts nocturnal pollinators. The health benefits of Govenia utriculata var. capitata include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects.
